bundle.shortDescription: Every Claude Code session and dispatched child, as one fleet seen three ways
bundle.longDescription: Desktop app for the mnemo agentic development environment: every Claude Code session you run and every child you dispatch as one fleet, seen three ways. Orbit shows who needs you at a glance, Console is where you work in a session with its live terminal, and Score is the day over time. Each session shows what it spent, what it read from memory and what it looked at.
